mapper.select: SELECT r.*, p.nickname, doc.real_name AS realName, u.avatar FROM consult_reply r LEFT JOIN patient_info p ON r.sender_id = p.user_id AND r.sender_type = 0 LEFT JOIN doctor_info doc ON r.sender_id = doc.user_id AND r.sender_type = 1 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON r.sender_id = u.id WHERE r.consult_id = #{consultId} ORDER BY r.create_time ASC

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT item.id) FROM ( -- 场景1：私密问诊分配给当前医生，暂时没有聊天回复（新待接诊问诊） SELECT c.id FROM consult c WHERE c.is_public = 0 AND c.doctor_id = #{receiveId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consult_reply r WHERE r.consult_id = c.id)
UNION
-- 场景2：已有对话，存在他人发送的未读消息（原有逻辑） SELECT r.consult_id FROM consult_reply r LEFT JOIN consult c2 ON r.consult_id = c2.id WHERE r.is_read = 0 AND r.sender_id != #{receiveId} AND (c2.user_id = #{receiveId} OR c2.doctor_id = #{receiveId}) ) AS item

SELECT DISTINCT item.id FROM ( -- 场景1：全新一对一待接诊问诊（无聊天记录） SELECT c.id FROM consult c WHERE c.is_public = 0 AND c.doctor_id = #{receiveId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM consult_reply r WHERE r.consult_id = c.id)
UNION
-- 场景2：对话中有未读消息的问诊 SELECT r.consult_id FROM consult_reply r LEFT JOIN consult c2 ON r.consult_id = c2.id WHERE r.is_read = 0 AND r.sender_id != #{receiveId} AND (c2.user_id = #{receiveId} OR c2.doctor_id = #{receiveId}) ) AS item
